Onboarding._comment: Environment-configurable KYC->FCCM onboarding. Switching FCCM environments is a config change, not a code edit. Username/Password override the deprecated top-level FccmOnboarding* keys. IncludeCustomerName: legacy FCCM schema REQUIRES CustomerName; the current env REJECTS it (HTTP 400) -> false here. Flip per environment. Defaults (CustomerType/Jurisdiction/CountryOfResidence/BusinessDomain) apply until KYC Section-A capture supplies real per-customer values. ApplicationIdFormat: {0} = customer code.

Diagnostics._comment: Module-wise diagnostic logging — the new-stack equivalent of the legacy custom-DLL + NLog dedicated log files. 'Files' defines one dedicated daily-rolling file per area; each file's 'Level' controls how much it captures and 'Enabled' turns it on/off. Level is a Serilog level: 'Error'/'Fatal' = errors only, 'Warning' = warnings+errors, 'Information' = normal (API request/response + lifecycle), 'Debug'/'Verbose' = full detail (onboarding payloads, FCCM responses, every Oracle FCC_OB_RA poll, risk-param derivation). FILES: 'Application.UserManagement' = Auth/Users/Roles API calls; 'Application.Trade' = all other API calls (Transaction/KYC/Flags/Workflow/Reports/...) plus FCCM onboarding detail; 'BackgroundService' = hosted services (FccmCaseIdPoller + LogArchiver). Each Application.* file logs end-to-end API request+response bodies (sensitive endpoints redacted) and full exception inner-chains. RetentionDays: rolled files older than this are zipped by LogArchiverService into backlogs_<from>-<to>.zip (originals deleted); ArchiveScanIntervalHours controls how often it checks. LogDirectory is relative to the API content root unless absolute.
Diagnostics._LogDirectory_note: Absolute path used here (dev). If left RELATIVE (e.g. "Logs") it resolves against the app content root = the published/deployed folder: published under IIS at C:\inetpub\wwwroot\TradeCompliance\ -> logs at C:\inetpub\wwwroot\TradeCompliance\Logs\. RECOMMENDED for production: an ABSOLUTE path OUTSIDE the web-served folder (e.g. C:\ProgramData\ICBC\TradeCompliance\Logs or D:\Logs\TradeCompliance) so logs are not web-accessible and survive redeploys; grant the app-pool identity write access. Override per-environment via appsettings.Production.json.

Brains._comment: BRAINS v2.0 QueryKycInfoServlet. Mode=Sandbox returns canned responses so UI sanity isn't blocked while localhost BRAINS is down; Program.cs blocks Sandbox in Production. The BE sends ONLY the mandatory params; ZoneNo/AdjustType/RegType/RegNo are configurable defaults.
